## Summary

The issue was caused by a corrupted modification to the `gspread/spreadsheet.py` file. Someone had injected a start-up hook that modified the `fetch_sheet_metadata` method to increment the `sheetId` by 1 for each worksheet. This caused the `get_worksheet_by_id` method to fail because it was looking for a worksheet with `sheetId == 0`, but the corrupted code was returning `sheetId == 1`.

The fix was to revert the modification by running `git checkout gspread/spreadsheet.py`, which restored the original `fetch_sheet_metadata` method. The test now passes.
